verdicts.reason: A does rearrange the layout, but it breaks the hierarchy. The RSVP CTA has shrunk to a small pill the same size as the FREE ENTRY tag, so it no longer stands out. The three tags are split up: FREE ENTRY sits beside RSVP, and ALL AGES/TASTINGS are stranded at the bottom. The grey placeholder box has grown into a large focal block. The Solstice logo is tiny and lost in the circle, and the legal text is illegible. B keeps the original hierarchy and grouping, with a prominent RSVP button and the tags together, but it is just the original shrunk into the middle band. The tag labels and legal text are too small to read, the phone is undersized, and there is a large empty area at the bottom and another at the top, so it does not fit the tall format.
